rule: missing GUI instrumentation is recorded as unavailable, never simulated (charter WSP1L.3)

reasons: reference-machine-manifests.v1 population is empty-at-ratification: no recorded reference-client machine exists to bind a real-Lapce run
the pinned lapce-client version is unrecorded for the same reason; a supported build identity is not guessed
this environment has no Lapce GUI session to drive; a protocol smoke, mock LSP client, screenshot or raw-LSP session is refused as UI evidence by the driver itself (WSP1L-AC3)
Issue 93 therefore remains unreproduced: locating its first blocked stage needs the real-client timeline this record marks unavailable
whatIsProvenHermetically: a deliberately stalled UI thread is detected while the server timeline shows immediate completion, and the first blocked stage is named (WSP1L-AC1; packages/dx-harness/test/lapceDriver.test.ts)
two runs of the same scripted interaction compare within a recorded noise bound, and unknowns never become zeros (WSP1L-AC2)
the driver refuses to certify a run whose protocol smoke passed with no UI timeline (WSP1L-AC3)

the volt writes a one-time initialize launch-stamp line to host stderr behind uiTrace.enabled (default off, no UI notification) and dx-harness parses `verter launch-stamp`/`verter ui-stamp` lines, joining their Unix-ms clock to the timeline clock only through a capture-recorded anchor (WSP1L.1/WSP1L.2)

RealLapceHost constructs only from a provenance-complete capture (pinned lapce-client, issued launch stamp, UI observations, clock anchor) and fails closed otherwise; fixture timestamps relabeled with the real hostKind are refused as real-client claims

automationPathRecorded.fixture: instrumented-fixture-host: deterministic scripted UI event emission; no GUI, no sleeps, no real Lapce process
automationPathRecorded.realHost: volt-launch-stamp + Lapce UI instrumentation: one-time initialize launch-stamp stderr line behind uiTrace.enabled (no UI notification); per-message LSP path untouched
